notes:
The KTDB (Korea Transport Database) national passenger O/D update rebuilds the base-year (2023) trip matrix and forecasts demand to 2050. Two zone systems are reconciled: 250 si-gun-gu zones nationwide, and finer eup-myeon-dong zones inside six metro areas (Seoul Capital Area, Busan-Ulsan, Daegu, Gwangju, Daejeon-Sejong-Chungcheong, Jeju). Base-year O/D is built mode by mode: bus/rail use actual ridership statistics; private-car and other personal modes go through a five-step expansion combining travel-survey samples, telecom big data, and card/TCS data, with bidirectional and zero-cell corrections. The draft O/D is validated against observed traffic counts via cordon-line/screenline %ERROR checks and FHWA-style assignment validation, iterating until errors meet tolerance. Socioeconomic indicators (population, employment, enrollment, land-use plans) are projected per target year, then a standard four-step model (generation/attraction, distribution, mode split, assignment) is applied consistently across national and regional models to produce future O/D matrices.

Reviewer triage (2026-09-20): scored on the September 2026 KMP wave rulings — the submitted answers are the same copied profile corrected wave-wide, and the v0.4.0 bundle carries the same pipeline fingerprints: commuterPopulation = population/1.2 exactly (83.3%), job totals are KTDB attraction-derived rather than census employment (3.52M jobs vs 2.59M residents in a 3.11M-person study area), and the district job/resident ratio remains uncorrelated with real workplace geography (Gunsan National Industrial Complex 0.76 vs residential districts up to 1.75 vs citywide 1.35) — no workplace-specific signal below the zone, so intensity stays size_only. Jeonju-Gunsan-Iksan lies outside the six KTDB regional models, so zone counts and the O/D matrix carry national si-gun-gu grain (adm2) — the non-metro wave profile (low 0.31). Recorded bound: the v0.4.0 demand fabric is finer than the wave generation (median node spacing ~217 m vs ~400 m), which would support mesh_250 resolution on both pillars (0.33, same tier); deliberately held at the wave profile for pack consistency — apply the resolution uplift pack-wide if/when the v0.4.0 generation is rescored. O/D metric structured_marginals per the wave ruling (expansion-built all-purpose matrix; cannot outrank the seoul listing's observed commuting matrix).
